ai_agent_apis.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
ai_agent_apis.description: Open protocol for tool and context integration across LLM clients and servers. Donated to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) on 2025-12-09, alongside Block's goose and OpenAI's AGENTS.md. Streamable HTTP is the preferred remote transport; the 2026-07-28 spec makes MCP servers formal OAuth 2.1 resource servers (RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata, RFC 8707 Resource Indicators).

ai_agent_apis.name: MCP Specification
ai_agent_apis.description: Versioned MCP specification index. Current finalized version is 2025-11-25; the 2026-07-28 release candidate was locked 2026-05-21 and ships 2026-07-28 (still forthcoming as of 2026-07-11) — it drops protocol-level sessions/Mcp-Session-Id from Streamable HTTP, adds Extensions, Tasks, MCP Apps, and hardened OAuth 2.1-aligned authorization. Follow current stable version from here.
